verdict.rationale: Discord's own docs show channels inside servers, threads that branch conversations off a channel, Private Threads available for all servers, and server events covering channel updates and role creation. A community report notes age-restricted channels that unverified users cannot access, a form of access gating. However, nothing explicitly documents creating private channels or managing channel membership and permissions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of private channels, per-channel membership/permission controls (e.g., role-based channel access), and independent hands-on corroboration of admin channel organization.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can organize conversations into public and private channels with membership controls

citations.quote: A Thread is a quick way to branch a conversation off of a channel’s main feed without removing it from the channel itself.
